summary: Jinneng revised FOB Qingdao offers; others quote 1,320-1,330 CIF (Oct)
NSRP to open spot sale of 2,475 tonnes; 114G holding flat ~VND 40,xxx/kg
Lotte Korea mid-week cargo sold out; Korean/Chinese yarn flat to firmer
paras: Today, September 16, China's Jinneng plant revised its PP export offers on an FOB Qingdao (China) basis to Vietnamese buyers. Accordingly, offers for all products rose USD 10/tonne from the start of the week. Specifically, PP yarn/injection was offered at USD 1,290-1,295/tonne/FOB and BOPP at USD 1,300/tonne/FOB, with an ETD in October 2026 (October shipment); PP copolymer injection was offered at USD 1,320/tonne/FOB with an ETA in September 2026… The CIF price to Vietnam adds about USD 30-40/tonne over the FOB offers above.

In practice, some other suppliers were offering Jinneng's PP yarn/injection to Vietnam at USD 1,320-1,330/tonne/CIF for October-delivery cargoes. One distributor offered Petrochina's T30S and L5E89 PP yarn at the same USD 1,320/tonne/CIF, for October 2026 delivery. Some traders raised their offers for Jinneng and Petrochina PP yarn/injection to USD 1,330-1,350/tonne/CIF but closed no deals.

Meanwhile, other market sources said Lotte Chemical Korea's PP cargo offered to Vietnam in the middle of last week had sold out, and other import offers were fairly sparse. Russia's Sibur PP yarn was quoted at VND 38,000-38,500/kg including VAT at Hai Phong port, though Sibur's distributor said their volumes were very small and were prioritized for regular customers to maintain the relationship rather than offered widely.

Domestically, Nghi Son Refinery and Petrochemical LLC (NSRP) has just announced it is preparing to open spot sales of 2,475 tonnes of PP resin, grade NSY104G/raffia fiber 4.5, for delivery from September 22-25, 2026; the volume may vary within a 20% range at NSRP's option. With this, NSRP has so far offered about 10,500 tonnes of PP for September delivery, slightly down from the previous month's offered volume (12,000 tonnes).

In the market, after the steep increase at the start of this week, offer levels for NSRP's PP yarn 114G are currently holding flat in the VND 40,000-40,500/kg including VAT range, on par with offers for PP yarn from other domestic producers such as BSR and Hyosung Vina. Domestic spot inventories are thin, supporting sellers in holding firm on prices. Some processing buyers have also had to accept purchases at this level, as it is hard to find cheaper prompt-delivery material and out of concern that prices could rise further in the short term…

Imported PP yarn/injection of certain Korean and Chinese origins ranged from flat to edging slightly up. For example, offer prices for PP yarn of Lotte and Hyundai (South Korea) origin were recorded at VND 40,000-40,300/kg including VAT in the north; Chinese-origin PP yarn/injection was offered at port at VND 39,000-40,000/kg including VAT for cargoes soon to arrive…

For other PP grades and product lines, prices also trended from flat to slightly higher. Offer levels for PP copolymer of various origins were commonly in the VND 40,000-41,000/kg including VAT range; PP Film/coating and random grades of Thai and Korean origin… were commonly in the VND 41,500-42,500/kg including VAT range.

summary: PTT LDPE Film pushed to 1,650 CIF; Sibur LLDPE VND 38,500-39,000/kg
Domestic spot scarce; Yulong 7042 up to VND 40,800/kg; HDPE 40,000-44,000
paras: The PE market this week is seeing numerous re-export offers from China to Vietnam, of diverse origins, mostly for October-November 2026 delivery. At the same time, more offers of US- and Middle Eastern-origin PE have been recorded, with the common thread being that offers are trending higher than the previous week and are for delivery from October onward…

As compiled today, September 16, offers for Petrochina (China) LLDPE Film 7050 to Vietnam were announced at USD 1,320-1,330/tonne/CIF, for October 2026 delivery, up sharply by USD 70-75/tonne from the start of last week. Some suppliers offered coal-based LLDPE Film of Shenhua and Baofeng (China) origin at USD 1,280-1,300/tonne/CIF, and oil-based LLDPE Film of ZPC and Huatai (China) origin at a very high USD 1,370-1,380/tonne/CIF…

One distributor offered OQ Oman's LLDPE Film to Vietnam at USD 1,280-1,290/tonne/CIF, for November 2026 delivery; Equate Kuwait's LLDPE Film at USD 1,300-1,320/tonne/CIF; Equate's HDPE Film 6888 at USD 1,380-1,395/tonne/CIF with an LSD of October 25, 2026; Saudi Arabia's Sabic LLDPE film grades at USD 1,330-1,360/tonne/CIF for October delivery (November-delivery offers at USD 1,310-1,340/tonne/CIF depending on grade); Sabic's HDPE Film at USD 1,350-1,370/tonne/CIF; Qatar's Qatofin LDPE Film at USD 1,600/tonne/CIF for November delivery; and Marlex's HDPE at USD 1,350-1,370/tonne/CIF and Marlex's HDPE blow at USD 1,370-1,390/tonne/CIF, for October delivery…

For Southeast Asian material, Lotte Titan Malaysia has offered October-cargo PE imports to Vietnam, with prices up sharply from the previous month. Titan's offers for LDPE Film/Shrink film this month rose sharply by USD 180/tonne from the same period last month to USD 1,580-1,600/tonne/CIF; its LDPE coating 800YY offer also rose USD 180/tonne to USD 1,680/tonne/CIF; while its LLDPE injection 300YY offer rose USD 140/tonne to USD 1,640/tonne/CIF. Offers for Petronas Malaysia-origin HDPE 9254F (blown film) were at USD 1,340-1,360/tonne/CIF. PTT of Thailand's LDPE Film 2426K offer rose sharply to USD 1,650/tonne/CIF…

“PE import offers from all producers are at high levels, and processing buyers have shown more interest in buying, but the gap between offer prices and buyers' target prices remains fairly wide. For Chinese-origin LLDPE Film, for example, a survey found suppliers might accept sales at USD 1,300-1,330/tonne/CIF for oil-based material, but most buyers were still only bidding at USD 1,250-1,280/tonne/CIF, not yet ready to commit to imports at higher prices.

Likewise, PTT of Thailand this week pushed its LDPE Film offer sharply up to USD 1,650/tonne/CIF and quoted LLDPE injection and HDPE yarn to some customers at USD 1,500/tonne/CIF, but closed no deals. In fact, one or two weeks ago many trading customers had contracted PTT's LDPE Film at USD 1,480-1,500/tonne/CIF and PTT's LLDPE and HDPE at USD 1,300-1,310/tonne/CIF, so this week traders find it hard to accept a jump of more than USD 150/tonne after just one or two weeks,” a source analyzed.

Russia's Sibur LLDPE Film was quoted at VND 38,500-39,000/kg including VAT at Hai Phong port. However, Sibur's distributor said their volumes were very small and were prioritized for regular customers to maintain the relationship rather than offered widely.

Domestically, spot PE remained fairly scarce and prices continued to be pushed up. Midweek, LDPE Film grades of PTT (Thailand), Lotte Titan and Petlin (Malaysia), Saudi Arabia's Sabic, Borouge (UAE)… were offered sharply higher by northern traders, to VND 46,000-47,000/kg including VAT, up VND 3,000-4,000/kg from late last week. Lotte Korea's LDPE Film 512 was offered at VND 45,500/kg including VAT. US-origin LDPE Film was also offered up to VND 40,000-41,000/kg including VAT…

For LLDPE, with scarce spot volumes, offers among trading firms in the market were fairly chaotic, with wide gaps between quotations. For example, in the south, one distributor quoted Saudi Arabia's Sabic LLDPE Film 218WJ and 219ZJ at up to VND 45,000-46,000/kg including VAT; offered US Dow's LLDPE Film 2645G, 2645.11GY and 2607G at VND 43,000-44,000/kg including VAT; and offered PTT of Thailand's LLDPE Film 7610A at VND 44,000/kg including VAT… Even so, in the north, one buyer said they had closed a purchase of Sabic's LLDPE Film 218WJ at VND 43,000/kg including VAT.

Yulong (China)-origin LLDPE Film 7042 was also offered up to VND 40,800/kg including VAT (for a cargo expected to arrive at Hai Phong port on September 20). One distributor offered Iran-origin LLDPE Film 18L01 and 18L02 at VND 39,500-40,000/kg including VAT for a cargo expected to arrive on September 28… These are all additive-free grades.
For HDPE, offer levels across grades were commonly in the VND 40,000-44,000/kg including VAT range…

summary: China coal SG-5 imports 790-795 USD/ton; freight & container issues persist
Domestic Zhongtai/Yihua SG-5 re-quoted; oil-based being raised further
Inventories high; some traders holding large stock resist further increases
paras: PVC offers from China to Vietnam have not been overly abundant recently, due to high freight rates, great difficulty booking shipping space amid severe congestion, and capacity cuts at some of the country's large producers.
Today, import offer levels for coal-based SG-5 PVC of Chinese origin to Vietnam were mostly at USD 790-795/tonne, and Chinese-origin oil-based PVC at USD 820-840/tonne/CIF…

Domestically, a market survey today, September 16, found one leading PVC distributor quoting coal-based SG-5 PVC of Zhongtai and Yihua (China) origin at VND 22,900-23,000/kg including VAT, delivered at Yen Vien, Dong Anh (Hanoi), excluding freight, for delivery in 3-4 weeks. This offer was up VND 600/kg from early September. In the market, many traders also quickly raised their offers for coal-based Chinese SG-5 PVC to VND 23,300-23,500/kg including VAT in the north…

For oil-based PVC, some distributors continued to raise prices. However, as noted, domestic PVC inventories are high, and some traders holding large stocks contracted the previous month adjusted their prices less than other distributors, widening the gap between offer prices.

For example, for oil-based SE950/SE1000 PVC of US Shintech origin and some Southeast Asian oil-based PVC grades, the major distributor Stavian offered up to VND 25,000/kg including VAT. However, a leading trading distributor in the north offered oil-based PVC of the AGC Group (such as Thailand's Vinythai, Indonesia's Asahimas and Vietnam's AGC Vina) at VND 23,900-24,000/kg including VAT…
